templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from baseline-vs-ours by the note-writer: single-frame numbered loop (six steps cycling Server Health Monitor to Diagnostics to Hyrax Inventory to VM Scheduler and back) with an online/offline split, not two contrasted panels; this is a control-loop figure, not baseline-vs-ours.
